arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Baskin argued the First Amendment protects objectively based lawsuits.
Mr. Wallace argued the NLRB must review such lawsuits.
Chief Justice Rehnquist asked if the case is submitted.

The NLRB argues it must review lawsuits to protect labor rights.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the boundary between business litigation and labor regulation. It determines whether the NLRB can review private lawsuits. It shapes the balance between free speech and labor law enforcement.
